I’d suggest adding a short bio and a few examples of your work or interests so visitors can get to know you better. I could only access a brief text snippet, so I can’t comment on the visual design.

I’d suggest adding a short introduction to the blog and highlighting a few hiking stories or favorite trails to give visitors something to explore. I could only access a brief text snippet, so I can’t comment on the visual design or full blog posts.

final_text:
Visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack, and sent both of them feedback:

- **Dora:** Suggested adding a short bio and examples of her work or interests.
- **Eve:** Suggested adding a blog introduction and highlighting hiking stories or favorite trails.
